subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: Should `appServer.requestTimeoutMs` become the supported upper bound for both WebSocket/Unix upgrade handshakes and subsequent control-plane requests?
rationale: The code avoids indefinite hangs without adding configuration, but it intentionally changes the shipped meaning of an existing operator setting and can terminate unusually slow upgrades.

options.title: Reuse request timeout
options.body: Approve the current single-budget contract, keeping the existing 60-second default and documented operator override for both handshake and request waits.

options.title: Add a separate handshake budget
options.body: Require a distinct setting or policy before merge, accepting another configuration surface to avoid changing the meaning of `requestTimeoutMs`.

recommendation.title: Reuse request timeout
recommendation.body: Approve the current single-budget contract, keeping the existing 60-second default and documented operator override for both handshake and request waits.
